Eight complete current rows, frozen over the frozen helpers and chains with every guard, quantifier order, status and defect distinction exact: Chromatic X3 `stable_cover_unique_induced_path_statement` (forall s, exists n before G, arbitrary finite index family, stable cover, exactly s vertices with s = 0 allowed, unique cover intersection), Chromatic X83 `aravind_rainbow_induced_chromatic_path_statement` (nonempty, triangle-free, arbitrary palette, proper colouring, exactly chi(G) rainbow vertices), GTMisc X91 `avoidable_path_or_pk_free_statement` (0 < k; no induced k-vertex path, or one whose every induced two-ended extension lies in an induced cycle), Extremal X98 `polynomial_kuhn_osthus_induced_subdivision_statement` (uniform polynomial after H and before s/G, 1 <= s, forbidden K_{s,s} subgraph, average-degree bound), GTMisc X114 `subcubic_induced_subdivision_np_complete_statement` (existential pattern, subcubic guard, in-NP and NP-hard halves through the D7 problem record; the D7 representation limitation is retained), Minor X67 `theta_triangle_free_bounded_degree_treewidth_statement` (uniform f, 4 <= t, Delta bound, triangle-free, no induced theta with its three paths, interior disjointness and no cross edges; solved status unchanged), Packing U9 `lovasz_path_removal_statement` (uniform f before k/G/x/y, distinct endpoints, f(k)-connectivity, whole induced path plus k-connectivity of the complement including k < |U|), GTMisc X208 `Pt_free_maximum_independent_set_polytime_statement` (forall t, 7 <= t, the complete positive algorithmic assertion with exact program/polynomial cost/encoding and maximum size output; partial status unchanged).
